measured: 19 October 2026, MacBook Pro M5 Max (128 GB), mlx 0.32.3, mlx-vlm 0.7.6
prompt_set: 231 decisions from the JevBench public set, rendered with the model's own jev_format (scripts/jevbench_to_requests.py)
reference: independent PyTorch reference (transformers 5.19, bf16 weights, fp32 attention, no mask in the 16 full-attention layers) on 39 of the 231 prompts; the original bf16 weights on MLX for all 231

causal_control_vs_pytorch.note: the same weights read causally, as a plain conversion would

speed_note: one decision at a time, 120 prompts (median 147 tokens), other models running on the same Mac; prompts of 3-4K tokens take 3.5-6 s; peak memory measured on the longest prompt (3,970 tokens)
